tickets.title: Coordinate estate document review with outside counsel
tickets.text: Coordinate with Galen Copperwisp at Paper Otter Law to review Leah and Marcus Nettlewhisk’s 2012 trust, will, durable power of attorney, and health directive package against the household’s current assets, dependents, and legacy preferences.
tickets.evidence: Leah requested coordination with Galen Copperwisp at Paper Otter Law so the older trust, will, durable power, and health directive package can be reviewed against the household’s current assets, dependents, and legacy preferences; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-06-07.

tickets.title: Research successor trustee alternatives
tickets.text: Research successor trustee alternatives for Leah and Marcus Nettlewhisk’s revocable trusts, including Velvet Acorn Trust Company and other fiduciaries. Address Edmund Nettlewhisk’s death and Callie Nettlewhisk’s relocation outside the United States.
tickets.evidence: Leah and Marcus want information on naming Velvet Acorn Trust Company or another fiduciary as successor trustee; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-06-14.

tickets.title: Review Benefits Enrollment Choices
tickets.text: Review Leah Nettlewhisk’s Moonbadger Robotics open enrollment packet for benefit elections, HSA/FSA options, life and disability coverage, beneficiary designations, and retirement plan contribution changes before the enrollment window closes. Check the life insurance and retirement plan beneficiary screens before she finalizes employer benefit elections.
tickets.evidence: the life insurance and retirement plan beneficiary screens need to be checked before she finalizes employer benefit elections; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-06-03.

tickets.title: Collect missing estate and beneficiary records
tickets.text: Obtain signed copies of Leah and Marcus Nettlewhisk’s health care directives, Marcus’s SEP IRA beneficiary confirmation, and Leah’s full employer life insurance beneficiary page for the estate binder.
tickets.evidence: the estate binder did not include signed copies of the health care directives, Marcus could not locate his SEP IRA beneficiary confirmation, and Leah did not have the full employer life insurance beneficiary page available during the call; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-06-10.

tickets.title: Reconcile beneficiary designations with estate and guardianship preferences
tickets.text: Reconcile beneficiary designations across Leah’s IRA, employer life insurance, Marcus’s SEP IRA, and the estate plan. Compare the records with the couple’s current trustee and guardianship preferences, including contingent beneficiaries.
tickets.evidence: the records discussed in the meeting showed different beneficiary structures across Leah’s IRA, employer life insurance, Marcus’s SEP IRA, and the estate plan, including contingent beneficiaries that do not match the couple’s current trustee and guardianship preferences; the agreed follow-up is due

tickets.title: Resolve custodian portal estate record issue
tickets.text: Follow up on the obsolete trust certification displayed in the Velvet Acorn Custody portal and the missing updated contact information in the shared document vault.
tickets.evidence: Leah reported that the Velvet Acorn Custody portal still displays an obsolete trust certification and that a prior upload of updated contact information did not appear in the shared document vault; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-05-30.

tickets.title: Summarize account titling for estate alignment
tickets.text: Summarize the titling differences between the joint taxable account, cash reserve accounts, and one older individual account and the revocable trust structure described in the estate documents for attorney review.
tickets.evidence: the joint taxable account, cash reserve accounts, and one older individual account are titled differently from the revocable trust structure described in the estate documents, so the titling needs to be summarized for attorney review; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-06-18.
